scope: Pure immutable controlled-action request binding; no service route, authenticated approval, durable consumption or executor

findings.detail: Opaque Intent constructor and pure predicates enforce syntactic invariants, fixed 24-element typed JSON array serialization, domain-separated SHA-256 request/effect digests, dual-clock (UTC and monotonic boot) window and 2000ms drift bounds, control-character/byte-length reason filtering, and constant-string error redaction ('invalid_controlled_action_request') without claiming execution authority.

Minor syntactic permissiveness (non-blocking): identifier/1 permits leading, trailing, or consecutive slashes (e.g. '//' in plan or target.job). This does not introduce serialization ambiguity or digest collision because all fields are JSON-encoded as distinct array elements and matched exactly.

13 deterministic unit tests cover golden canonical JSON/SHA-256 vectors, per-field sensitivity across Binding/Target/Window/reason/nonce, effect_id stability across retry fences and sensitivity to identity/job changes, identifier/host/boot/digest/window/reason rejection bounds, and valid_at expiry, domain, and clock-jump boundaries.

Safety delta accurately scopes the change as a pure data descriptor prerequisite, preserves the 4 STPA UCA categories and unreduced 1-5 FMEA ratings, records all design review b6ee7573 corrections, and leaves checklist obligations and EV-94..109 admission states unclaimed.
